scene.label: Act 5, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Rome. A public place

lines.text: See you yond coign o' the Capitol, yond cornerstone?
lines.plainText: See you yond coign o' the Capitol yond cornerstone

lines.text: Why, what of that?
lines.plainText: Why what of that

lines.text: If it be possible for you to displace it with your little finger, there is some hope the ladies of Rome, especially his mother, may prevail with him. But I say there is no hope in't. Our throats are sentenced and stay upon execution.
lines.plainText: If it be possible for you to displace it with your little finger there is some hope the ladies of Rome especially his mother may prevail with him But I say there is no hope in't Our throats are sentenced and stay upon execution

lines.text: Is't possible that so short a time can alter the condition of a man?
lines.plainText: Is't possible that so short a time can alter the condition of a man

lines.text: There is differency between a grub and a butterfly, yet your butterfly was a grub. This Martius is grown from man to dragon. He has wings; he's more than a creeping thing.
lines.plainText: There is differency between a grub and a butterfly yet your butterfly was a grub This Martius is grown from man to dragon He has wings he's more than a creeping thing

lines.text: He loved his mother dearly.
lines.plainText: He loved his mother dearly

lines.text: So did he me; and he no more remembers his mother now than an eight-year-old horse. The tartness of his face sours ripe grapes. When he walks, he moves like an engine, and the ground shrinks before his treading. He is able to pierce a corslet with his eye, talks like a knell, and his hum is a battery. He sits in his state as a thing made for Alexander. What he bids be done is finished with his bidding. He wants nothing of a god but eternity and a heaven to throne in.

lines.text: Yes, mercy, if you report him truly.
lines.plainText: Yes mercy if you report him truly

lines.text: I paint him in the character. Mark what mercy his mother shall bring from him. There is no more mercy in him than there is milk in a male tiger. That shall our poor city find, and all this is long of you.
lines.plainText: I paint him in the character Mark what mercy his mother shall bring from him There is no more mercy in him than there is milk in a male tiger That shall our poor city find and all this is long of you

lines.text: The gods be good unto us.
lines.plainText: The gods be good unto us

lines.text: No, in such a case the gods will not be good unto us. When we banished him, we respected not them; and he returning to break our necks, they respect not us.
lines.plainText: No in such a case the gods will not be good unto us When we banished him we respected not them and he returning to break our necks they respect not us

lines.text: Sir, if you'd save your life, fly to your house.
lines.plainText: Sir if you'd save your life fly to your house

lines.text: The plebeians have got your fellow tribune
lines.plainText: The plebeians have got your fellow tribune

lines.text: And hale him up and down, all swearing if
lines.plainText: And hale him up and down all swearing if

lines.text: The Roman ladies bring not comfort home,
lines.plainText: The Roman ladies bring not comfort home

lines.text: They'll give him death by inches.
lines.plainText: They'll give him death by inches

lines.text: What's the news?
lines.plainText: What's the news

lines.text: Good news, good news! The ladies have prevailed.
lines.plainText: Good news good news The ladies have prevailed

lines.text: The Volscians are dislodged and Martius gone.
lines.plainText: The Volscians are dislodged and Martius gone

lines.text: A merrier day did never yet greet Rome,
lines.plainText: A merrier day did never yet greet Rome

lines.text: No, not th' expulsion of the Tarquins.
lines.plainText: No not th' expulsion of the Tarquins

lines.text: Friend,
lines.plainText: Friend

lines.text: Art thou certain this is true? Is't most certain?
lines.plainText: Art thou certain this is true Is't most certain

lines.text: As certain as I know the sun is fire.
lines.plainText: As certain as I know the sun is fire

lines.text: Where have you lurked that you make doubt of it?
lines.plainText: Where have you lurked that you make doubt of it

lines.text: Ne'er through an arch so hurried the blown tide
lines.plainText: Ne'er through an arch so hurried the blown tide

lines.text: As the recomforted through th' gates. Why, hark you!
lines.plainText: As the recomforted through th' gates Why hark you

lines.text: This is good news.
lines.plainText: This is good news

lines.text: I will go meet the ladies. This Volumnia
lines.plainText: I will go meet the ladies This Volumnia

lines.text: Is worth of consuls, senators, patricians
lines.plainText: Is worth of consuls senators patricians

lines.text: A city full; of tribunes such as you
lines.plainText: A city full of tribunes such as you

lines.text: A sea and land full. You have prayed well today.
lines.plainText: A sea and land full You have prayed well today

lines.text: This morning for ten thousand of your throats
lines.plainText: This morning for ten thousand of your throats

lines.text: I'd not have given a doit. Hark, how they joy!
lines.plainText: I'd not have given a doit Hark how they joy

lines.text: First, the gods bless you for your tidings; next, accept my thankfulness.
lines.plainText: First the gods bless you for your tidings next accept my thankfulness

lines.text: Sir, we have all great cause to give great thanks.
lines.plainText: Sir we have all great cause to give great thanks

lines.text: They are near the city?
lines.plainText: They are near the city

lines.text: Almost at point to enter.
